title: Nepal’s Booming Fintech Sector: AI, Software, Money, and the Future of Nepali Youth | Sanjib Subba |
description:
In this episode of Thinking Beyond Podcast, we sit down with Sanjib Subba to explore the rapidly evolving world of financial technology, Nepal’s digital transformation, entrepreneurship, and the future of the country’s economy.

With extensive experience across banking, learning and development, and fintech, Sanjib shares his insights on how technology is transforming financial services and why Nepal has enormous potential to become a stronger player in the global fintech industry.

We also discuss Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), artificial intelligence, the biggest challenges facing Nepal’s fintech ecosystem, and how young people can develop the skills needed to succeed in this rapidly changing industry.Beyond business and technology, the conversation takes a deeper turn into personal growth, career transitions, overcoming failure, finding opportunities, and the importance of leaving behind meaningful work.

description:
Behind one of Nepal's biggest YouTube talk shows: Dashrath Sunar, Founder  of VFY (Voice For Youth) Talks, joins Thinking Beyond Media for a long, honest conversation about media, money, sponsorship, tourism, and building a global brand from Nepal.


Originally from Kanchanpur in Sudurpashchim Province, he moved to Kathmandu and launched VFY Talks on YouTube. He chose a high-production, premium format at a time when most people expected talk shows to stay on television. His first guest was the legendary actor Rajesh Hamal. Since then the VFY family has grown to include VFY Global, VFY Hindi, and a tourism-focused show.

title: Youngest Scientist Mohan Tamang: Dark Truth behind Nepali Startup |Global Space Economy| Policy|
description:
Mohan Tamang, founder and ceo of Mach24 Orbitals, is on a mission to push Nepal beyond its conventional boundaries and put the country on the global space technology map

His journey is not just about rockets and technology; it’s about challenging the status quo, taking risks, embracing failures, and believing in possibilities that others might consider impossible.

In this episode of Thinking Beyond Podcast, Mohan shares his journey from starting with limited resources to exploring the challenging world of rocket development. He opens up about his first rocket launch, the failures and lessons behind it, the challenges of building a space-tech company in Nepal, and why attracting international venture capital remains difficult for Nepali businesses.

We also explore the future of Nepal’s space industry, his vision for Orbital Nepal, the importance of SETS Nepal, team management, personal sacrifices, and the expectations he has from the government.

title: Nepal’s Real state Multi-Millionaire: Future | Scams |Policy | Money | Satakshi Mishra|
summary:
Co-Founder of Skill Sewa, Satakshi has been contributing to Nepal’s construction and real estate sector by providing professional services, including home inspections, construction-related solutions, and property services. What began with just four employees has grown into an organization employing hundreds of people directly and creating opportunities for thousands more through indirect and part-time employment.

 Skill Sewa is Nepal’s first home inspection company, offering a wide range of services, including interior design, renovation, construction, house design, waterproofing, and more. Here’s why Skill Sewa is your one-stop solution for home improvement. They have also introduced several new ventures, including the White Room and Colony concepts.

Her journey reflects the importance of creating opportunities rather than simply waiting for them. Instead of limiting herself to traditional career expectations, she stepped into an industry where she saw room for improvement and innovation.

description:
In this episode of Thinking Beyond, we sit down with Saurav Dhakal, Founder and CEO of Golden Tech International, to explore his journey in entrepreneurship, technology, and innovation.
Specializing in AI and blockchain solutions, Saurav is working to connect technology with real-world business needs. From his early days of freelancing to building a technology company that serves global businesses, his journey opens up important conversations about ambition, challenges, and the opportunities available to young entrepreneurs in Nepal.

                We dive deep into the world of Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, AI agents, and blockchain, exploring how these technologies are transforming businesses and reshaping the future of work. Saurav also shares insights into working with international clients, building professional networks, and the challenges of creating a successful technology startup.

Can Nepal build its own IT based unicorn company? Can someone without a coding background start an IT business? Will AI replace jobs, or create new opportunities? And what will Nepal’s technology industry look like in the next 10 years?

We also explore the potential of AI for everyday people and local businesses, the importance of continuous learning, and the mindset young people need to turn their ideas into reality.

title: Can Nepal Build a Unicorn? | Truth Behind Nepali Startup Ecosystem Nobody Talks | NJ Subedi |
summary:
NJ Subedi’s journey is an inspiring example of how self-learning, experimentation, and persistence can turn ideas into successful businesses. After stepping away from college, he pursued his entrepreneurial ambitions.Through Yarsa Games, the company entered the global mobile gaming industry, reaching millions of users and demonstrating that products developed in Nepal can succeed internationally.

But his vision extends beyond gaming. Through Yarsa Tech, NJ is working toward expanding Nepal’s electronics and hardware manufacturing capabilities, with the ambition of creating technology products locally rather than relying heavily on imports

        However, building technology businesses in Nepal comes with significant challenges, including high operating costs, taxes on imported components, limited payment infrastructure, and difficulties protecting intellectual property. NJ has called for policy reforms to reduce unnecessary costs, support IT exports, improve access to international payment systems, and create a more business-friendly environment for Nepali technology companies. His journey raises an important question: Can Nepal become a country that not only consumes technology but also builds and exports it to the world?

title: The Unseen Battle Behind the 400 Cr Empire |Ten Group|Adversity |Trust Building|
summary:
In this episode, We sat down with Dheeraj kumar Agrawal. No degree. No safety net.  Today, Dhiraj Kumar Agarwal, founder of Ten Group, runs a Rs 400 crore business empire in Nepal. Most people would have given up. 

Dhiraj turned to the one thing the accident couldn't take from him: his mind. Starting in hardware in 2011, he built from zero, with no academic strength to lean on, only courage and a refusal to let adversity define him. Over the years, that mindset grew into one of Nepal's biggest business stories.In this conversation, he goes back to the beginning: the accident, the self-doubt, the people who underestimated him, the risks that could have ended everything, and how he built an empire with his mind.

◼ What should actually happen when a rape or sexual violence case is reported—and how survivors should be supported
◼ What high-profile cases reveal about the gap between Nepal’s laws, institutions and reality.

title: Rekha Yadav (Finance awareness creator) |Stock Market| Author
summary:
Today’s guest is Rekha Yadav , She had a double degree in Economics and Finance, a stable job at Siddhartha Bank — and she walked away from it all to bet on herself.

In this episode of Thinking Beyond, we sit down with a young entrepreneur from Janakpur who turned financial uncertainty into financial freedom. From learning to trade on NEPSE to building a personal brand around financial awareness, her journey is proof that small-town beginnings don't limit big ambitions.

Today, she is a stock market trader and financial awareness content creator, brand ambassador for three national and international companies, founder of her own IT company, and owner of her own clothing brand — living proof that leaving the "safe path" can lead somewhere far bigger. 
        In this conversation, we talk about the fear of quitting a secure job, learning to trade from scratch, building multiple businesses at once, and what it really takes to go from a small town in Janakpur to national recognition. If you've ever doubted whether you can build something of your own, this episode is for you.
